name: Motor Cooling
description: Thermal analysis of the electric motor. Checks whether predicted operating temperature stays within the safety threshold.

elements.name: Motor Operating Temperature
elements.description: Operating temperature of the motor under load. Uncertain due to variable driving conditions and cooling efficiency.

uncertainty.source: Thermal analysis and early experimental data

elements.name: Maximum Permissible Motor Temperature
elements.description: Motor design and safety constraint threshold

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(T_motor) = T_motor if T_motor <= T_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The constraint T_motor ≤ T_max acts as a guard. The propagation is active (returns the value) only when the safety bound is respected; otherwise the intersection is empty, signalling inconsistency.
